about: Undelimited and mangled maths as the model writes it, and the text it must become. Read by apps/server/tests/test_math_repair_corpus.py (repair_markdown: 'tagged' exactly), apps/web/src/lib/latex.test.ts and apps/server/ui/src/shared/latex.test.ts (processLatex of 'input' equals processLatex of 'tagged'), so the three cannot drift. 'tagged' uses graspy's <latex-inline> and <latex-block> tags; text that is not maths has tagged equal to input.

cases.name: a matrix environment with no delimiters, after a left-hand side, with a lengthened line break
align has no inline form, so it is written as aligned
cases with a lengthened line break
a worksheet line of commands joined by \qquad is one span, blanks as escaped underscores
a fraction with nested commands and a blank
a run inside a sentence takes its short words and numbers, not the prose
cases.input: With df = n-1 = \underline{\phantom{___}}, the critical t value is found.
cases.tagged: With <latex-inline>df = n-1 = \underline{\phantom{\_\_\_}}</latex-inline>, the critical t value is found.

cases.name: a lone command in a sentence
two commands side by side are one span
plain text with numbers and operators is not maths
cases.input: For n = 10 and 5 + 3 = 8, the mean is 4.5 - 1.
cases.tagged: For n = 10 and 5 + 3 = 8, the mean is 4.5 - 1.

cases.name: a display span keeps the lengthened line break inside it
a dollar span with blanks keeps its place
maths already tagged is left as it is
inline code is left as it is
